senses.gloss: f. ch. = h.סִיעָה , company, troop, band, party.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Joshua 9:2">Targ. Josh. IX, 2</cite> <he>ס׳ חדא</he> (h. text <he>פה אחד</he>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Samuel 2:25">Targ. II Sam. II, 25</cite> (h. text <he>אגדה</he>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 11:28">Targ. Y. Gen. XI, 28</cite>; a. fr.—
Targ. Prov. XXVII, 22 בגו ס׳ (ed. Wil. סִיַעְתָּא) in the public assembly (v. אוּרְדָּךְ).—

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 64:9">Gen. R. s. 64</cite> (expl. <he>אחזת מרעהו</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 26:26">Gen. XXVI, 26</cite>) <he>סִיעַת מרחמוהי</he> a suite of his friends (fr. Targ. O. a. l.).—Pl. <he>סִיעָן</he>, <cite ref="O00775"><he>סִיעָתָא</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 31:3">Targ. Jer. XXXI, 3</cite> (<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 31:4">4</cite>) <he>סִיעָן משבחין</he> (h. text <he>מחול משחקים</he>); ib. XXV, 10 <he>סִיעַת דמשבחין בנהור בוצין</he> (h. text <he>רחים ואור נר</he>). Ib. XLIX, 3 (h. text <he>גדרות</he>); ib. XLVIII, 37 (h. text <he>ידים</he>).

<cite ref="Targum of II Chronicles 15:6">Targ. II Chr. XV, 6</cite>; a. e.—[<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 46:2">Targ. Ps. XLVI, 2</cite> <cite ref="O00775"><he>סִיעֲתָא</he></cite> ed. Wil., v. <cite ref="O00629"><he>סַיַּיעְתָּא</he></cite>.]
